m150_K100.note: range_term_over_Rmax = 7*nH*ln(2/delta_B)/(3*(m-1)); Rmax cancels exactly because b0 = nH*Rmax_hat, so this term depends only on (n,T,delta_B,m), not on how B_Q/Rmax_hat is estimated.
